events.verdict: Lopez (MIL) and Antetokounmpo (MIL) both get their hands on the ball and it is dislodged from Duren's (DET) possession. Any ensuing contact with Duren is incidental.

Replay review of the foul called on Cunningham (DET) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Cunningham does not establish a legal guarding position in Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path prior to his upward shooting motion on the driving shot attempt.

events.verdict: The ball is last touched by Sasser (DET) prior to it going out of bounds.
Cunningham (DET) reaches in and the contact with Prince's (MIL) arm during his driving shot attempt is marginal.
Cunningham (DET) places an extended arm towards Prince (MIL), but does not illegally ward him off.
Lopez (MIL) brushes Duren's (DET) arm and does not affect his dunk.
Trent Jr. (MIL) makes slight contact to Beasley's (DET) face as he attempts to create space, but the contact is marginal.
Harris (DET) turns after the dribble hand-off but he avoids delivering contact to Prince (MIL).
Antetokounmpo (MIL) maintains a legal guarding position during Cunningham's (DET) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Lopez (MIL) contacts the rim during Cunningham's (DET) shot attempt, but it does not cause the ball to take an unnatural bounce and has no chance to score.
Trent Jr. (MIL) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Cunningham (DET).
Trent Jr. (MIL) and Cunningham (DET) come together in attempt to recover the loose ball and the contact is incidental.
Holland (DET) has a leg extended in Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path, but he moves through the contact and makes his intended pass.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) gathers the ball on his left foot and takes two steps before releasing the pass.
Trent Jr. (MIL) briefly grasps Beasley's (DET) jersey during the throw-in and releases without affecting his FOM.

Antetokounmpo (MIL) cleanly blocks Holland II (DET) during his shot attempt at the rim and any ensuing contact is incidental. The foul call is incorrect, but officials trigger a replay review to determine the timing of the foul call. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the foul call occurred before the expiration of the game clock and the clock is reset to 00:01.0. The foul call could not be changed to a no-call at replay and only the timing of the foul call is a reviewable matter.
